criteria.reason: It directly says it would report to the road traffic authority, satisfying the direct-stance requirement.
It frames safety versus freedom/autonomy and explains why safety outweighs, but does not transparently balance alternatives.
It mentions an authority-ordered medical/psychological assessment but omits the regular 75+ medical check and doctor reporting.

summary: The response gives a direct report-first stance and names safety versus freedom, but skips the required stepwise medical-first approach.
